name: io.github.m2ai-mcp-servers/chartinghero
description: MCP server for clinical charting with Claude - document patient visits to EMR

environmentVariables.name: POINTCARE_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: EMR API base URL (optional - runs in mock mode if not set)

environmentVariables.name: POINTCARE_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: EMR API key (required for production mode)

environmentVariables.name: SUPABASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Supabase project URL for dashboard sync (optional)

environmentVariables.name: SUPABASE_SERVICE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Supabase service role key for dashboard sync (optional)
